tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The documents shall be furnished in accordance with all the conditions mentioned in Section VII of the tender document.
All the terms and conditions as per the tender document.
The collective weighted average margin rate payable to KMF on all verities of items shall be considered for H1 evaluation instead individual margins.

The bidder shall consider the transportation and distribution charges for the area covering Dharwad, Belagavi, Gulbarga, Vijayapur-Bagalakhot, Haveri, and Ballari (North karnatak districts) Milk unions marketing areas
Successful bidder on demand should supply the products to other markets also as per KMF instructions.
For ease of co-ordination, monitoring, logistics, hygiene etc., the bidder has to compulsorily quote for all the above listed items. Bids with ZERO quotes for any item will be summarily rejected.
Rates quoted by the Tenderer shall be fixed / constant during the Tenderers performance of the Contract and subject to variation only in pursuance of Clause 29 Other Tender Conditions.
